name: AI Tools Directory
blurb: Commercial and open source AI products, with pricing, strengths, weaknesses, alternatives, and governance notes.

reading.body:
The AI Tools Directory holds no tools directly, but its catalog lists 320 tools across 23 categories, with 63 in-depth profiles covering pricing, strengths, weaknesses, and governance notes.

The catalog is the substantive layer. The directory itself is a hub with zero entries, so any evaluation of enterprise AI tooling must go through the catalog rather than the top level. The 63 profiles add governance notes, which matters for organizations deciding what to deploy, but the data does not say which tools those profiles cover or how current the pricing is.

The data does not connect any tool to compute demand, data center capacity, or grid constraints. It is a product inventory, not an infrastructure map, and it cannot show which tools are compute-intensive or where they run.
